description: This file defines a mock class 'WrapsImplMock' for the 'WrapsImpl' interface, utilizing Google Mock framework to facilitate unit testing of code that interacts with system-level functions such as 'setmntent', 'system', 'popen', 'pclose', etc. The mock class sets default behaviors for certain functions and mocks multiple system-related methods for testing purposes.

classes.name: WrapsImplMock
classes.description: A Google Mock class to simulate 'WrapsImpl' behaviors for unit testing, providing mock implementations for system interaction functions.

methods.name: WrapsImplMock()
methods.description: Constructor that sets up default behavior for 'setmntent' function, delegating calls to the real 'setmntent' implementation.

methods.name: system
methods.description: Mocked method to simulate system command execution.

methods.name: popen
methods.description: Mocked method to simulate opening a process by creating a pipe.

methods.name: pclose

methods.name: syslog

methods.name: setmntent

methods.name: getmntent

methods.name: v_secure_system
methods.description: Mocked method for executing system commands securely with variadic arguments.
